lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: qualitative graph interpretation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A car accelerates steadily, then travels at a constant speed, then decelerates to a stop. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?

steps: While accelerating, the speed graph rises, so it is increasing.
While traveling at a constant speed, the graph is flat, so it is constant.
While decelerating to a stop, the graph falls, so it is decreasing.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 4, height goes from 18 to 12.
From t = 4 to t = 10, height goes from 12 to 19.
From t = 10 to t = 16, height goes from 19 to 19.
Which interval shows the height decreasing?
Consider the relation {(9, -6), (-10, -10), (3, -8), (-7, -10)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Yes, this relation is a function.
It is a function only if every output is different.
No, this relation is not a function.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.

items.prompt: Which set of ordered pairs does NOT represent a function?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 4x - 11, find the value of x for which f(x) = 45.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt:
Function A is given by f(x) = 3x + 17. Function B is given by the table:
x: 4, 9
y: 12, 47
Which function has the greater rate of change?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
